DECLARE
 temp_catalog_no VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 sZLotPos NUMBER:=0;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :s_catalog_number := upper(:s_catalog_number);
 
 
 --This procedure validates the concatenated scan of catalog number and lot number.
 -- Check data identifiers
 
IF :s_catalog_number!='M' then 
 
 
 IF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND -- catalog number (scanninng with the container ID)
 substr( :s_catalog_number, 13, 2 ) = '&)' THEN -- lot number identifier
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,12), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; -- substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,13);
 End If;
 
 ELSIF substr(:s_catalog_number, 1, 2) = '=)' AND substr( :s_catalog_number, 12, 2 ) = '&)' then -- for catalog number without continer ID 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,1,11), temp_catalog_no);
 check_package_failure;
 If form_failure then 
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= ''; 
 Else
 :catalog_number := temp_catalog_no;
 :s_lot_number:=SUBSTR(:s_catalog_number,12);
 End If;
 
 ELSE -- catalog scan only 
 
 VALIDATE_CATALOG_NO_SCAN_ISBT(:s_catalog_number, temp_catalog_no);
 If form_failure then
 :s_catalog_number := '';
 :catalog_number:= '';
 ---:s_bag_code_desc := '';
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 if length(temp_catalog_no)=10 then
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; ----substr(temp_catalog_no,2);
 else
 :catalog_number :=temp_catalog_no; 
 end if;
 
 END IF; 
END IF;

END;

procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_group in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_proc_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 select decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_proc_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_proc_date,v_sysdate),
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_proc_date,v_sysdate)+(life_span / 24)),
 life_span_ind
 into p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_product_attributes
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type 
 and attrib_group = p_attr_group
 and attrib_code = p_attr_code
 and life_span is not null
 and life_span_ind is not null
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr
 WHERE attrib_code = p_attr_code
 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 );
 if temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 then
 p_new_expdate := 
 to_date(to_char(p_new_expdate,'mmddyyyy')||'235959','mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 p_new_expdate := :expiry_date;
end;

 p_old_product_code in varchar2,

 -- This procedure is essentially a copy of INSERT_COMPONENT (from SBCLIB:LIB)
 -- without the actual insertion into the components table and also without Interdiction
 -- checks. This has been put here to be called before we print labels, so that we don't 
 -- print a label and discover only at the time of verification that the component cannot
 -- actually be made. 
 

 -- P_OLD_PRODUCT_CODE is an overloaded field used as follows
 -- depending on P_PROCESS:
 -- MODIFY CONVERT SPIKED stores old product code
 -- DEFINE stores number of bags used
 -- REJECT stores the reject reason_code
 temp_time_limit number(10,2);

 temp_min_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_weight number(10,2);
 temp_max_weight number(10,2);

 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_pheresis_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_calculated_time VARCHAR2(10);

 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id'); 
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 copy(p_unit_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 copy(p_chapter_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 copy(to_char(p_coll_date),'GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 copy(p_product_code,'GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 begin
 select ffp_freeze_durn, max_bleed_time, slow_bleed_time
 into temp_ffp_freeze_durn,
 temp_max_bleed_time, temp_slow_bleed_time
 from chapters

 begin

 nvl(pheresis_flag,'N')
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_temp,
 temp_time_limit, temp_product_type, temp_pheresis_flag

 where product_code = substr(p_product_code,1,5)

 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin

 third_sep_time, bleed_start_time,
 bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_first_sep_time, temp_second_sep_time,
 temp_third_sep_time, temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_bleed_end_time, temp_contract_id

 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date)

 if temp_pheresis_flag = 'N' and

 if temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null or
 temp_second_sep_time is null
 then
 show_error('0138');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('WB','DUWB')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is not null
 then
 show_error('0260');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPL','RPFF',
 'DUFFP','DURPL','DURPF','PLSM')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null
 then
 show_error('0083');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','DUFFP')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is not null and
 temp_second_sep_time is not null and
 temp_third_sep_time is not null
 then
 show_error('0079');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null
 then

 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 IF temp_product_type = 'PLSM' THEN

 temp_x varchar2(1);

 select 'x' into temp_x

 where exists

 and coll_date = p_coll_date

 -- set bags_used based on procedure

 -- aliquotted products will be stopped prior to this point

 if p_process = 'CONVERT' and
